scripts.test:java-emulator: f() { firebase emulators:exec --only firestore "NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-vm-modules' jest --maxConcurrency 1$(printf ' %q' "$@")"; }; f
scripts.test:rust-emulator: f() { export FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8080; RUST_LOG="${RUST_LOG:=OFF}" ../target/debug/firestore-emulator & PID=$!; cleanup() { if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then kill -INT "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; i=0; while [ "$i" -lt 50 ] && kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; do sleep 0.1; i=$((i + 1)); done; if kill -0 "$PID" 2>/dev/null; then kill -KILL "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi; wait "$PID" 2>/dev/null || true; }; trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM; node -e 'const pid = Number(process.argv[1]); const deadline = Date.now() + 10_000; (async () => { while (Date.now() < deadline) { try { process.kill(pid, 0); } catch { console.error("firestore-emulator exited before becoming ready"); process.exit(1); } try { const r = await fetch("http://127.0.0.1:8080/emulator/v1"); if (r.ok) { await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 50)); process.kill(pid, 0); process.exit(0); } } catch {} await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 25)); } console.error("Timed out waiting for firestore-emulator on 127.0.0.1:8080"); process.exit(1); })();' "$PID" || return 1; RUST_EMULATOR=true NODE_OPTIONS='--experimental-vm-modules' jest "$@"; }; f
